zh: 她一下子就看穿了他的借口。
en: She {saw through} his excuse straight away.

zh: 回想起来，那是我做过最好的决定。
en: {Looking back}, it was the best decision I ever made.

zh: 我不相信那些关于加密货币的炒作。
en: I don't {buy into|believe|believe in|fall for} all the hype about crypto.

zh: 这跟我所有的信念都背道而驰。
en: It {goes against} everything I believe in.

zh: 这个工作机会我能考虑几天吗？
en: Can I {think over|think about|consider} the offer for a few days?

zh: 我一会儿就会想起来的。
en: It'll {come back} to me in a minute.

zh: 有时候你得退一步，看看全局。
en: Sometimes you need to {step back} and look at the bigger picture.

zh: 这首歌勾起了我好多回忆。
en: This song {brings back} so many memories.

zh: 我过了好一会儿才反应过来。
en: It took me a while to {catch on|get it|understand|realise|realize}.

zh: 如果失败了会怎么样，你仔细想过吗？
en: Have you {thought through|thought about|considered} what happens if it fails?

zh: 让我考虑一晚上，明天回复你。
en: Let me {sleep on|think about|think over|mull over} it and I'll get back to you tomorrow.

zh: 一下子信息太多，我消化不了。
en: It's too much information to {take in|absorb|digest|process} at once.

zh: 回想起来，我当初应该接受那份工作。
en: {Thinking back|Looking back}, I should have taken that job.

zh: 我在权衡要不要接受悉尼的工作。
en: I'm {weighing up|considering} whether to take the job in Sydney.

zh: 我老是把这对双胞胎弄混。
en: I keep {mixing up|confusing} the twins.

zh: 他的说法前后对不上。
en: His story just doesn't {add up|make sense}.

zh: 让我考虑一两天你的提议。
en: Let me {chew over|think over|think about|mull over|sleep on|consider} your offer for a day or two.

zh: 说到底，这取决于时机。
en: It all {comes down to|boils down to|depends on} timing.

zh: 她迅速判断了一下形势，然后叫了救护车。
en: She {sized up|assessed|weighed up|took in} the situation quickly and called an ambulance.

zh: 别急着做决定，慢慢想。
en: Don't {rush into|jump into|hurry into} a decision. Take your time.

zh: 说到底，一切都取决于钱。
en: In the end, it all {boils down to|comes down to} money.

zh: 你觉得新老板怎么样？
en: What do you {make of|think of} the new boss?

zh: 你得正视这个问题，不能再逃避了。
en: You need to {face up to|face|deal with|confront|accept} the problem instead of avoiding it.

zh: 虽然一开始很难，但最后一切都顺利解决了。
en: It was hard at first, but everything {worked out} in the end.

zh: 让我考虑一下再答复你。
en: Let me {mull over|think over|think about|consider} the offer before I give you an answer.

zh: 原来他一直都是对的。
en: It {turned out} that he was right all along.

zh: 老师那句话我一直记在心里。
en: What my teacher said has always {stuck with} me.
